data_leakage_risks.description: Found 4 exact duplicate image pairs with identical SHA-256 hashes under different filenames. Naive splitting would leak training samples into validation/test.
85 images are high-resolution DJI drone captures taken in bursts at identical tower inspection locations. Random splitting across frames of the same flight will cause spatial/visual leakage.
